novel_reason: Calculates a rolling Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) over the current UTC session. When price sweeps the session high or low on a 1h clock but CVD fails to confirm (printing a lower high or higher low), it triggers a mean-reversion trade targeting the session VWAP, filtered by a low ADX to ensure a range-bound regime.
